title: 窗口函数：部门工资 Top-N（ROW_NUMBER）
expected_output:
各 dept 内按工资降序取前 2 名:
  dept=eng: [9000, 8000]  (ROW_NUMBER 排名 1~2)
  dept=hr: [5000, 4000]  (ROW_NUMBER 排名 1~2)
  dept=sales: [8500, 8000]  (ROW_NUMBER 排名 1~2)

等价 SQL: SELECT dept, sal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY sal DESC) rn FROM emp WHERE rn<=2
窗口函数由 OVER 子句定义分区/排序, 不缩减行数(与 GROUP BY 不同), 常配合 rn<=N 做组内 TopN
code:
# 模拟 Hive 窗口函数: 每个部门工资 Top-2 (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY sal DESC))
from collections import defaultdict

emp = [
    ("eng", 6000), ("eng", 9000), ("eng", 7000), ("eng", 8000),
    ("sales", 8000), ("sales", 3000), ("sales", 8500),
    ("hr", 5000), ("hr", 4000),
]
by_dept = defaultdict(list)
for d, s in emp:
    by_dept[d].append(s)
print("各 dept 内按工资降序取前 2 名:")
for d in sorted(by_dept):
    top = sorted(by_dept[d], reverse=True)[:2]
    print(f"  dept={d}: {top}  (ROW_NUMBER 排名 1~{len(top)})")
print("\n等价 SQL: SELECT dept, sal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY sal DESC) rn FROM emp WHERE rn<=2")
print("窗口函数由 OVER 子句定义分区/排序, 不缩减行数(与 GROUP BY 不同), 常配合 rn<=N 做组内 TopN")
